shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat stone surface
enclosed rectangular field / framed panel (A has a border band, B a framed field)
repeated small geometric units (rosette band in A; lozenge lattice in B)
justification: A shows a narrative procession of bearded human figures leading horned rams in profile above a decorative rosette band, while B shows a purely abstract composition: an arched stone with a framed field of lozenge lattice, a vertical bar, and a crescent-like curve with circular shapes below. The only correspondence is the generic use of shallow relief with a framed field and a repeated small geometric motif, which is far too commonplace to indicate any shared iconographic scheme.
